agent-mesh: update an installed Mac to the version in this checkout.
  ./update.sh [--lang en|zh-CN] [--yes] [--no-pull] [--plan] [--manual] [--repo-url URL]
  --plan     show what differs and what would run, then exit; the deployment is not changed
  --no-pull  use this checkout as is; otherwise git pull --ff-only runs first
  --yes      skip the one confirmation at the start
  --manual   update the cloud side by hand: pause the routine, send Grok Bot a command block and paste its reply
  --lang     language of the terminal text and the routine prompt; default: the recorded one, then AGENT_MESH_LANG,
             then en
  --repo-url the repository the cloud installs from (default: the public agent-mesh repository); the cloud scripts
             in this checkout must match its release tag v<VERSION>, which is checked online before anything changes
It updates this Mac first (relay, dsh plugin, Reason Network). When the routine prompt changed, it shows the new one
for you to paste into the routine. When the cloud side changed, it sends Grok Bot an update request from this Mac,
waits up to 15 minutes for the reply, checks it and records it. The first time after v0.8.1 or earlier, Grok Bot
asks you once in Grok before it runs the update.
It also refreshes the filled-in reply convention in ~/.local/lib/agent-mesh/templates.
Exit: 0 done or already up to date, 1 not fully done (see the summary), 2 usage, 3 needs a terminal (nothing changed).
